description: Action button. One primary per view; danger stays outline.

content.description: The button's label. Sits between the two icons when both are given.

variant.description: Which action this is. Danger is outline, never filled.

size.description: Height, from the density tokens, so the button re-densifies inside .arena-compact.

icon.description: Phosphor class name drawn before the label. Replaced by the spinner while loading.

iconRight.description: Phosphor class name drawn after the label — a caret on a menu trigger, an arrow on a next action.

loading.description: Replaces the leading icon with a spinner and blocks activation. The spin slows under reduced motion rather than stopping — a frozen spinner reads as a hung process.

disabled.description: Blocks activation and dims the control. Implied by loading.

type.description: Native button behaviour. Defaults to 'button' so a button inside a form does not submit it by accident.

name.description: Submitted with the form, when the button submits one.

form.description: The id of the form this button belongs to, when it is not a descendant of it.

click.description: The button was activated, by pointer or by keyboard.
